text: The limit of (x squared - 1) / (x - 1) as x approaches 1 is:
subject: Mathematics
options: 0|2|1|Does not exist
explanation: Factor the numerator as (x-1)(x+1); the quotient becomes x+1 which tends to 2.

text: A function f is continuous at x = a if the limit of f(x) as x approaches a equals f(a). This statement is:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: All three conditions: f(a) exists; the limit exists; and the two are equal.

text: The limit of (sin x) / x as x approaches 0 is:
subject: Mathematics
options: 0|1|Infinity|2
explanation: This standard limit is proved geometrically using the squeeze theorem.

text: The intermediate value theorem requires the function to be:
subject: Mathematics
options: Continuous on a closed interval|Differentiable|Increasing|Periodic
explanation: A continuous function takes every value between its endpoint values.

text: State the definition of continuity of a function at a point.
subject: Mathematics
correctAnswer: The function is continuous at a point if the limit as x approaches the point exists and is equal to the value of the function at that point.

text: The derivative of x cubed is:
subject: Mathematics
options: x squared|3 x squared|3 x|x cubed / 3
explanation: Apply the power rule: bring down the exponent and reduce it by one.

text: The derivative of sin x is:
subject: Mathematics
options: cos x|-cos x|-sin x|tan x
explanation: The derivative of cos x is -sin x which is the companion result.

text: The chain rule states that the derivative of f(g(x)) equals f prime of g(x) times g prime of x. This statement is:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: Differentiate the outer function keeping the inner intact then multiply by the inner derivative.

text: At a local maximum of a differentiable function the derivative equals zero. This statement is:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: Fermat's theorem: an interior extremum of a differentiable function has a horizontal tangent.

text: State the product rule for differentiation.
subject: Mathematics
correctAnswer: The derivative of the product f g is f prime g plus f g prime.

text: The integral of 2x dx is:
subject: Mathematics
options: x squared + C|2 x squared + C|x + C|2 + C
explanation: Differentiating x squared + C gives back 2x.

text: The integral of 1 / x dx is:
subject: Mathematics
options: x + C|ln x + C|1 / x squared + C|e to the x + C
explanation: The natural logarithm is the antiderivative of the reciprocal function.

text: The fundamental theorem of calculus connects differentiation and integration. This statement is:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: It shows that integration is the inverse of differentiation and gives the evaluation rule for definite integrals.

text: The definite integral of 3x squared from 0 to 1 equals:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: An antiderivative is x cubed; evaluating from 0 to 1 gives 1 - 0.

text: Explain what an indefinite integral means.
subject: Mathematics
correctAnswer: It denotes the family of all antiderivatives of a function; any two members differ by a constant C.

text: The order of a differential equation is the:
subject: Mathematics
options: Degree of the highest derivative|Highest order derivative present|Number of independent variables|Power of x
explanation: An equation with y prime prime is of second order.

text: The general solution of dy/dx = y is:
subject: Mathematics
options: y = C e to the x|y = ln x|y = x squared|y = sin x
explanation: Separate variables: dy/y = dx; integrate to get ln|y| = x + C.

text: An equation of the form dy/dx + P(x) y = Q(x) is a first order linear ordinary differential equation. This statement is:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: It is solved using an integrating factor.

text: The integrating factor for dy/dx + P(x) y = Q(x) is e to the integral of P dx. This statement is:
subject: Mathematics
explanation: Multiplying through makes the left side the derivative of a product.

text: Define the order and degree of a differential equation.
subject: Mathematics
correctAnswer: The order is the highest derivative present; the degree is the power of that highest derivative when the equation is a polynomial in its derivatives.

text: The speed of light in vacuum is approximately:
subject: Physics
options: 3 x 10 to the 6 m/s|3 x 10 to the 8 m/s|3 x 10 to the 10 m/s|3 x 10 to the 4 m/s
explanation: It is denoted by c and is a universal constant in relativity.

text: The splitting of white light into its colours is called:
subject: Physics
options: Reflection|Dispersion|Absorption|Emission
explanation: Different wavelengths bend by different amounts in a prism.

text: Young's double slit experiment demonstrates the:
subject: Physics
options: Particle nature of light|Wave nature of light through interference|Gravitation of light|Charge of light
explanation: The alternating bright and dark fringes come from constructive and destructive interference.

text: The focal length of a plane mirror is infinite. This statement is:
subject: Physics
explanation: Its reflecting surface has no curvature so the focal length is taken as infinity.

text: State Huygens' principle.
subject: Physics
correctAnswer: Every point on a wavefront acts as a source of secondary wavelets and the new wavefront is the envelope of those wavelets.

text: The SI unit of electrical resistance is the:
subject: Physics
options: Volt|Ampere|Ohm|Watt
explanation: One ohm is the resistance that allows one ampere under one volt.

text: Ohm's law holds exactly when the:
subject: Physics
options: Temperature is kept constant|Current is zero|Circuit is open|Voltage is changing rapidly
explanation: V = I R for ohmic conductors at constant temperature.

text: The magnetic force on a moving charge is given by F = q v cross B. This statement is:
subject: Physics
explanation: The force is perpendicular to both the velocity and the field and equals q v B sin theta.

text: The unit of inductance is the:
subject: Physics
options: Henry|Farad|Coulomb|Tesla
explanation: A one henry inductor develops one volt when the current changes at one ampere per second.

text: State Kirchhoff's junction rule.
subject: Physics
correctAnswer: The total current entering a junction equals the total current leaving it; it is a statement of conservation of charge.

text: The photoelectric effect was explained by:
subject: Physics
options: Isaac Newton|Albert Einstein|Niels Bohr alone|James Maxwell
explanation: Einstein showed that light comes in quanta (photons) of energy h f; he won the Nobel Prize for this.

text: The energy of a photon is given by:
subject: Physics
options: E = h f|E = m c squared only|E = m v squared|E = h f / c
explanation: Energy is proportional to the frequency of the radiation.

text: In the Bohr model electrons occupy stationary orbits with quantized angular momentum. This statement is:
subject: Physics
explanation: An electron radiates energy only when it jumps between allowed orbits.

text: The energy released in the fission of uranium 235 comes from the mass defect converted by E = m c squared. This statement is:
subject: Physics
explanation: The products weigh slightly less than the reactants and the lost mass appears as energy.

text: State Heisenberg's uncertainty principle.
subject: Physics
correctAnswer: The product of the uncertainties in position and momentum is at least h over 4 pi; the two cannot be known exactly at the same time.

text: The first law of thermodynamics is a statement of:
subject: Physics
options: Increase of entropy|Conservation of energy|Newton's first law|Ohm's law
explanation: Energy can change form but the total energy of an isolated system is constant.

text: In an isothermal process the:
subject: Physics
options: Temperature is constant|Volume is constant|Pressure is constant|Heat exchange is zero
explanation: For an ideal gas internal energy depends only on temperature so delta U is zero in an isothermal change.

text: The efficiency of a Carnot engine depends only on the temperatures of the source and the sink. This statement is:
subject: Physics
explanation: No real engine can exceed the Carnot efficiency for the same reservoirs.

text: Absolute zero is:
subject: Physics
options: 0 degrees Celsius|0 kelvin (about -273.15 degrees Celsius)|100 kelvin|-100 degrees Celsius
explanation: It is the lower limit of the thermodynamic temperature scale.

text: State the second law of thermodynamics in the Clausius form.
subject: Physics
correctAnswer: Heat cannot of itself pass from a colder body to a hotter body; external work is required for refrigeration.

text: The bond formed by the sharing of electron pairs is the:
subject: Chemistry
options: Ionic bond|Covalent bond|Metallic bond|Hydrogen bond
explanation: Atoms share pairs to complete their valence shells.

text: The shape of the methane molecule is:
subject: Chemistry
options: Linear|Tetrahedral|Trigonal planar|Octahedral
explanation: Four equivalent C-H bonds point to the corners of a tetrahedron with 109.5 degree angles.

text: The VSEPR theory predicts molecular shape from the:
subject: Chemistry
options: Repulsion of electron pairs around the central atom|Mass of the central atom|Charge of the nucleus only|Colour of the compound
explanation: Electron pairs arrange themselves as far apart as possible.

text: Among H2O; H2S; HCl; and CH4 the strongest hydrogen bonding is shown by water. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: Oxygen is small and highly electronegative so O-H-O hydrogen bonds are strong.

text: Distinguish between an ionic bond and a covalent bond.
subject: Chemistry
correctAnswer: An ionic bond involves transfer of electrons between metal and non metal with electrostatic attraction and high melting points; a covalent bond involves sharing of electron pairs usually between non metals with lower melting points.

text: Gibbs free energy is defined as:
subject: Chemistry
options: G = H - T S|G = H + T S|G = U + P V only|G = T S - H
explanation: It combines enthalpy and entropy into one quantity for spontaneity at constant T and P.

text: A reaction is spontaneous when delta G is:
subject: Chemistry
options: Positive|Negative|Zero|Infinite
explanation: Delta G = 0 means the system is at equilibrium.

text: The entropy of a system increases when its disorder increases. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: Gases have higher entropy than liquids which have higher entropy than solids.

text: The enthalpy change of a reaction depends only on the initial and final states. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: Enthalpy is a state function; this is the basis of Hess's law.

text: State the first law of thermodynamics with its equation.
subject: Chemistry
correctAnswer: Energy of the universe is constant; for a system the change in internal energy equals heat added plus work done: delta U = q + w.

text: The device that converts chemical energy into electrical energy is:
subject: Chemistry
options: An electrolytic cell|A galvanic (voltaic) cell|A transformer|A capacitor
explanation: A spontaneous redox reaction drives the current in a galvanic cell.

text: The standard hydrogen electrode is assigned a potential of:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: All standard electrode potentials are measured relative to it.

text: The Nernst equation is used to calculate the cell potential under non standard conditions. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: It relates potential to the activities (concentrations) of the reacting species.

text: Corrosion of iron is essentially an electrochemical oxidation process. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: Iron acts as an anode and loses electrons in the presence of moisture and oxygen.

text: State Faraday's first law of electrolysis.
subject: Chemistry
correctAnswer: The mass of a substance deposited or liberated at an electrode is proportional to the quantity of electricity that passes through the electrolyte: m = Z I t.

text: The central metal ion in the complex [Co(NH3)6]Cl3 is:
subject: Chemistry
options: Chlorine|Cobalt|Ammonia|Nitrogen
explanation: Six ammonia ligands are coordinated to the cobalt inside the brackets.

text: The coordination number of the complex ion [Fe(CN)6] 3- is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: It equals the number of donor atoms bonded to the central metal; here six cyanide carbons.

text: Ammonia acts as a monodentate ligand. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: It donates a single lone pair from the nitrogen atom.

text: The complex [Co(NH3)6]Cl3 dissociates in solution into one complex cation and three chloride ions. This statement is:
subject: Chemistry
explanation: The ions inside the coordination sphere do not ionize; the counter ions do.

text: Define a ligand and a coordination entity.
subject: Chemistry
correctAnswer: A ligand is an ion or molecule that donates a lone pair of electrons to a metal; the coordination entity is the central metal with its ligands enclosed in brackets.

text: A variable in programming is:
subject: Computer Science
options: A named storage location whose value can change|A constant only|A function|A comment
explanation: Its value can be read and reassigned during execution.

text: In Python which of the following is an immutable data type:
subject: Computer Science
options: list|tuple|dict|set
explanation: Once created a tuple's elements cannot be changed.

text: The time complexity of binary search on a sorted array of n elements is:
subject: Computer Science
options: O(n)|O(log n)|O(n squared)|O(1)
explanation: The search space is halved at every step.

text: An infinite loop occurs when the loop condition never becomes false. This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: A missing or wrong update of the loop variable is the most common cause.

text: Distinguish between a compiler and an interpreter.
subject: Computer Science
correctAnswer: A compiler translates the whole source program into machine code before execution; an interpreter executes the source line by line at run time.

text: A stack follows the:
subject: Computer Science
options: FIFO principle|LIFO principle|Random access principle|Priority principle
explanation: The last element pushed is the first one popped.

text: A queue follows the FIFO principle. This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: The first element enqueued is the first one dequeued; it models waiting lines.

text: In a binary search tree the left child of a node holds keys:
subject: Computer Science
options: Larger than the node|Smaller than the node|Equal to the node|Always null
explanation: This ordering makes search traverse one side at a time.

text: The average time complexity of a hash table lookup with a good hash function is O(1). This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: Collisions degrade the worst case but the average stays constant for a good load factor.

text: State three applications of a stack.
subject: Computer Science
correctAnswer: Managing function calls (the call stack); evaluating arithmetic expressions; and matching brackets in code.

text: In a relational database a table is a:
subject: Computer Science
options: File|Relation|Class|Pointer
explanation: Rows are tuples and columns are attributes of the relation.

text: The SQL command used to retrieve data is:
subject: Computer Science
options: INSERT|SELECT|UPDATE|DELETE
explanation: SELECT specifies which columns and which rows to return.

text: The primary key of a table must be unique and not null. This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: It uniquely identifies every row of the table.

text: Normalization is used to reduce redundancy and update anomalies. This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: Each form of normal form removes a specific kind of dependency problem.

text: Explain what a foreign key is.
subject: Computer Science
correctAnswer: A foreign key is a column or set of columns in one table that references the primary key of another table; it enforces the relationship between the two tables.

text: An operating system manages:
subject: Computer Science
options: Only the CPU|The CPU; memory; files; and devices|Only the display|Only the keyboard
explanation: It acts as the resource manager between applications and hardware.

text: The process of switching the CPU between running processes is called:
subject: Computer Science
options: Context switching|Printing|Compiling|Booting
explanation: The saved state of one process is stored and the state of the next is restored.

text: The four Coffman conditions for deadlock are mutual exclusion; hold and wait; no preemption; and circular wait. This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: All four must hold simultaneously for deadlock to occur; removing any one prevents it.

text: Virtual memory allows processes to use disk space as an extension of RAM. This statement is:
subject: Computer Science
explanation: The page table maps virtual pages to physical frames and pages out rarely used pages.

text: List the four Coffman conditions required for deadlock.
subject: Computer Science
correctAnswer: Mutual exclusion; hold and wait; no preemption; and circular wait.
